g.text: Buzzer straight on the pin (strongest drive, about 40 mA).

g.desc: Buzzer straight on the pin (strongest drive, about 40 mA).

g.text: No status LED on this board (D6 unused): battery low and the pad state

g.desc: No status LED on this board (D6 unused): battery low and the pad state

g.text: without a ground station show only in telemetry (docs/INDICATORS.md).

g.desc: without a ground station show only in telemetry (docs/INDICATORS.md).

g.text: D8-D10 (SPI) and the B2B connector carry the Wio-SX1262: no PCB connection.

g.desc: D8-D10 (SPI) and the B2B connector carry the Wio-SX1262: no PCB connection.

g.text: GPIO numbers: include/board_pins.h. D6 (status LED) unused on this board.

g.desc: GPIO numbers: include/board_pins.h. D6 (status LED) unused on this board.

g.text: 5V, D8, D9, D10: header pins pulled on this board (no pads).

g.desc: 5V, D8, D9, D10: header pins pulled on this board (no pads).

g.text: BAT+ / BAT- are pads on the XIAO underside; BAT- is the pad nearest USB-C.

g.desc: BAT+ / BAT- are pads on the XIAO underside; BAT- is the pad nearest USB-C.

g.text: Antennas: LoRa on the Wio-SX1262 U.FL (always fitted before power-up).

g.desc: Antennas: LoRa on the Wio-SX1262 U.FL (always fitted before power-up).

g.text: This schematic is the wiring master of the flight computer.

g.desc: This schematic is the wiring master of the flight computer.

g.text: Change it together with include/board_pins.h and docs/HARDWARE.md,

g.desc: Change it together with include/board_pins.h and docs/HARDWARE.md,

g.text: Pyro CELL+, ARM, IGN+, IGN- 1.0 mm

g.desc: Pyro CELL+, ARM, IGN+, IGN- 1.0 mm

g.text: Default 0.4 mm; clearance 0.4 mm for all

g.desc: Default 0.4 mm; clearance 0.4 mm for all

g.text: Off-board: cell and main switch (J1), arm link (J3),

g.desc: Off-board: cell and main switch (J1), arm link (J3),

g.text: igniter (J4), GPS module on a lead (J5). H1-H4: M3 holes to the sled.

g.desc: igniter (J4), GPS module on a lead (J5). H1-H4: M3 holes to the sled.

g.text: Footprints: U1 Seeed dimensions, U2 SparkFun board file (v10),

g.desc: Footprints: U1 Seeed dimensions, U2 SparkFun board file (v10),

g.text: U3 outline provisional. Check with a 1:1 print before etching.

g.desc: U3 outline provisional. Check with a 1:1 print before etching.

g.text: Processor and radio: XIAO ESP32-S3 + Wio-SX1262

g.desc: Processor and radio: XIAO ESP32-S3 + Wio-SX1262

g.text: High-current loop (about 2.7 A for 1 s): J1 + -> J3 (ARM) -> R3 -> J4 igniter -> Q1 -> J1 -.

g.desc: High-current loop (about 2.7 A for 1 s): J1 + -> J3 (ARM) -> R3 -> J4 igniter -> Q1 -> J1 -.

g.text: R3: 1 ohm 2 W metal oxide; a pulse puts about 8 W in it for 1 s (2 s max): check its short-time overload.

g.desc: R3: 1 ohm 2 W metal oxide; a pulse puts about 8 W in it for 1 s (2 s max): check its short-time overload.

g.text: Net class Pyro: wide copper, Q1 source returns straight to J1 -, not through the logic ground.

g.desc: Net class Pyro: wide copper, Q1 source returns straight to J1 -, not through the logic ground.

g.text: R7 holds Q1 off while the ESP32 boots, resets or sleeps. Fit the arm link on the pad only.

g.desc: R7 holds Q1 off while the ESP32 boots, resets or sleeps. Fit the arm link on the pad only.

g.text: Continuity: the drain reads >= 60 % of the battery through an intact bridge (R4/R5, setting pyro_divider).

g.desc: Continuity: the drain reads >= 60 % of the battery through an intact bridge (R4/R5, setting pyro_divider).

g.text: L76K GNSS module off the board, on a 3-wire lead soldered to J5

g.desc: L76K GNSS module off the board, on a 3-wire lead soldered to J5

g.text: (pin numbers: Seeed schematic V1.0, XIAO positions):

g.desc: (pin numbers: Seeed schematic V1.0, XIAO positions):

g.text: J5.1 3V3 -> its 3V3, J5.2 GND -> its GND,

g.desc: J5.1 3V3 -> its 3V3, J5.2 GND -> its GND,

g.text: J5.3 GPS_TX <- its TXD (D7 position), 9600 baud.

g.desc: J5.3 GPS_TX <- its TXD (D7 position), 9600 baud.

g.text: At the module: RXD (D6), WAKE_UP (D0), RESET (D10) to its 3V3.

g.desc: At the module: RXD (D6), WAKE_UP (D0), RESET (D10) to its 3V3.

g.text: Ceramic patch antenna on U.FL, facing the nose. About 41 mA.

g.desc: Ceramic patch antenna on U.FL, facing the nose. About 41 mA.

g.text: GPS (optional): Seeed L76K on a lead

g.desc: GPS (optional): Seeed L76K on a lead

g.text: MPU-9250: AD0, INT, AUXCL, AUXDA pins pulled (0x68 via SJ2); nCS, VDDIO high, FSYNC low.

g.desc: MPU-9250: AD0, INT, AUXCL, AUXDA pins pulled (0x68 via SJ2); nCS, VDDIO high, FSYNC low.

g.text: One IMU axis along the rocket axis (any sign: "Set upright").

g.desc: One IMU axis along the rocket axis (any sign: "Set upright").

g.text: BMP280 (4-pin GYBMEP): VCC on 3V3; I2C address set on the board.

g.desc: BMP280 (4-pin GYBMEP): VCC on 3V3; I2C address set on the board.

g.text: Barometer: vented bay, foam, away from the ejection gases.

g.desc: Barometer: vented bay, foam, away from the ejection gases.

g.text: J1 1-2: cell (-, +), 3-4: main switch, both off-board. Pyro loop: CELL+ before the switch.

g.desc: J1 1-2: cell (-, +), 3-4: main switch, both off-board. Pyro loop: CELL+ before the switch.

g.text: C1 470 uF: rides through ms dips (radio bursts, contact flicker). Mind the polarity.

g.desc: C1 470 uF: rides through ms dips (radio bursts, contact flicker). Mind the polarity.

g.text: Charging: USB-C on the XIAO with the main switch on.

g.desc: Charging: USB-C on the XIAO with the main switch on.
